security.title: Security
security.slow: The security review is taking a while. Try publishing again in a moment.

security.blockingTitle: {count, plural, one {A security problem is holding back this publish} other {# security problems are holding back this publish}}
security.fixRequest: Fix these security problems before publishing:

rls_disabled.title: The table {table} has no RLS
rls_disabled.scenario: Anyone with the page's public key can read, change and delete all of its rows.
rls_disabled.fix: Turn on RLS for the table and add policies for what each person may do.

policy_open_write.title: The policy “{policy}” lets anyone change {table}
policy_open_write.scenario: Any visitor, without signing in, can change or delete rows in {table}.
policy_open_write.fix: Limit the policy to each row's owner (for example, auth.uid() = user_id).

secret_in_client.title: A {provider} secret key reaches the browser
secret_in_client.titlePrivateKey: A private key reaches the browser
secret_in_client.scenario: Anyone who opens the page can copy it and use it as you.
secret_in_client.fix: Take it out of the browser code, replace it with a new one, and use it only inside an Edge Function, as a secret.

test_secret_in_client.title: A {provider} test key reaches the browser
test_secret_in_client.scenario: It doesn't move real money, but anyone can use your test account with it.
test_secret_in_client.fix: Move it to an Edge Function secret.
